modules.title: Introduction to Karin Magana I (Idioms)
modules.html:
Common Hausa idioms and their meanings. This section covers introduction to karin magana i (idioms).

Key points

  • A ina ake samun 'Karin Magana' — Adabin Baka.
  • Karin magana: 'Komai nisan dare...' — Gari zai waye.
  • Cika karin magana: 'Komai nisan jifa ...' — ...kasa zai dawo..
  • Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Hankali .' — maganin komai.
  • Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya bar gida, _____.' — gida ya bar shi.

Worked examples

Q: A ina ake samun 'Karin Magana'?
A: Adabin Baka — Proverbs (Karin Magana) are transmitted orally, making them part of 'Adabin Baka' (Oral Literature).

Q: Karin magana: 'Komai nisan dare...'
A: Gari zai waye — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Gari zai waye.

Worked examples

Q: A ina ake samun 'Karin Magana'?
A: Adabin Baka — Proverbs (Karin Magana) are transmitted orally, making them part of 'Adabin Baka' (Oral Literature).

Q: Karin magana: 'Komai nisan dare...'
A: Gari zai waye — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Gari zai waye.

quiz.q: A ina ake samun 'Karin Magana'?
quiz.solution: Proverbs (Karin Magana) are transmitted orally, making them part of 'Adabin Baka' (Oral Literature).

quiz.q: Karin magana: 'Komai nisan dare...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Gari zai waye.

quiz.q: Cika karin magana: 'Komai nisan jifa ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...kasa zai dawo..

quiz.q: Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Hankali .'
quiz.solution: The proverb 'Hankali maganin komai' means wisdom/intelligence is the cure/solution to everything.

quiz.q: Kammala karin maganar nan: 'Kowa ya bar gida, _____.'
quiz.solution: This is a common proverb meaning if you abandon your origins, they will eventually abandon you.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Karin harshe' (Dialect)?
quiz.solution: Dialect refers to variations in pronunciation or vocabulary based on geographic regions.

quiz.q: Wanene ya rubuta 'Magana Jari Ce'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Abubakar Imam.

quiz.q: Wanene ya rubuta littafin 'Magana Jari Ce'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Abubakar Imam.

quiz.q: Wane ne marubucin littafin 'Magana Jari Ce'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Abubakar Imam.

quiz.q: A cikin kalmar 'Makarantu', guda nawa ne 'gaba' (syllables)?
quiz.solution: Ma-ka-ran-tu consists of four syllables.

quiz.q: Wanene ya kera wannan: 'Ina son mota _____.' (Black)?
quiz.solution: 'Baka' is the feminine adjective for black, agreeing with the feminine noun 'mota'.

quiz.q: A cikin tsarin lissafi, 'Dubu daya' nawa ne?
quiz.solution: 'Dubu daya' represents one thousand.

quiz.q: Abincin Hausawa mai farin jini:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Tuwo.

quiz.q: Wanene ya rubuta 'Ruwan Bagaja'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Abubakar Imam.

quiz.q: Matar Bayajidda:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Daurama.

quiz.q: Menene 'Money'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Kudi.

quiz.q: Menene 'Siffa' a Nahawun Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Adjective.

quiz.q: Menene ake nufi da 'Jinsi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Gender.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'Ruwa'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Water.

quiz.q: Mene ne jam'in kalmar 'Littafi'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Littattafai.

quiz.q: Wane ne sarkin kida a kasar Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Makaɗi.

quiz.q: Wakar 'Arewa Jamhuriyya' wakar wane ce?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Sa'adu Zungur.

quiz.q: Me ake cewa idan an gama tatsuniya?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Kungurus kan kusu.

quiz.q: Wanne ne kayan kidan Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kalangu.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Market' da Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Kasuwa.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Cold' da Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Sanyi.

quiz.q: Bayajidda from:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Baghdad.

quiz.q: Not Hausa Bakwai:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Zamfara.

quiz.q: Menene 'Mouth'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Baki.
